claims.statement: Tom Allen had denied a report that he was about to make a match with George Rooke, despite his earlier announced retirement from the ring.
claims.excerpt: and in the face of his recent denial of the report that he was about

claims.statement: Tom Allen went East to arrange the preliminaries for a fight with George Rooke, despite his retirement and his recent denial of the match.
claims.excerpt: he has gone East to arrange the preliminaries for that encounter

claims.statement: A deposit of $500 a side, one-sixth of the agreed stake, was held by Harry Hill for Allen's match with George Rooke.
claims.excerpt: a deposit of $500 a side, being one-sixth of the agreed stake, is now in the hands of Harry Hill

claims.statement: Tom Allen was matched to fight George Rooke within fifty miles of Pittsburg on 17 June 1875.
claims.excerpt: The fight is arrangefl to take place withiu fifty miles of Pittsburg, on the 17th of June.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was 36 years old in March 1875.
claims.excerpt: Not that his age—36—has begun to tell on

claims.statement: Tom Allen weighed about 210 pounds and would have to train down to 172 pounds to fight.
claims.excerpt: get down from his present 210 pound of adipose tothe 172 pounds of bone and muscle requisite to fit him

claims.statement: Tom Allen has fought only three long, drawn-out fights in his life, all of them in England several years earlier.
claims.excerpt: he has never fought but three dragging tichts in his life and those were ull fought in Englaud several Sears ago

claims.statement: Tom Allen beat McCoole in about a dozen minutes.
claims.excerpt: Allen will not chop him up, as he did McCoole, in a dozen minutes

claims.statement: Tom Allen weakened Gallagher in the first two or three rounds of a fight (the wording is unclear).
claims.excerpt: nor weaken his buck, as he did Gallagher's, inthe first two or three rounds

claims.statement: The longest time Tom Allen has stood up in the ring in the United States was 44 minutes with Mace, about 30 of them sparring.
claims.excerpt: The longest time he has stood up in’the ring in this country was 44 minutes with Mace

notes: The article is mainly about George Rooke and his record; only Allen's claims are recorded. The Rooke-Moore fight is not Allen's.
